generation_boundary.publisher_claim: Next-generation Hexagon adds an Element Accelerator and 50% larger shared memory; a 30B MoE example activates approximately 3B routed parameters and uses flash-to-memory expert management. generation_boundary.assessment: These announcements support a newer-platform research direction; they do not establish INT2 hardware execution, whole-model deployment or those performance gains on this razr. No Gen 6 result is counted as a v79 test.
